Los Angeles County Sheriff Robert Luna won reelection, defeating former Sheriff Alex Villanueva whom he had defeated four years ago, NBC Los Angeles projected Tuesday.

Among the ballots counted as of Tuesday night, Luna won over 70% of the votes, compared to Villanueva's 30%.
